//: Type-CHECKING only — noEmit, checkJs. Scoped to the pure *-logic.js files:
they have no imports, no Pinia, no window, and their output is a contract
the parity suites pin, so they are exactly where a type slip is both most
likely to matter and cheapest to catch. The .vue and store/ files are NOT
in scope yet (Vue SFCs need vue-tsc; the stores pull in Pinia types) — this
is the incremental first step, not a whole-app migration.
Deliberately loose: strict is OFF and noImplicitAny is OFF, so this documents
and catches real mistakes (undefined vars, wrong property access, bad arity)
without demanding every parameter be annotated. Tighten later, file by file.
